SELECT s.School, s.FundingType
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.City = 'Riverside'

SELECT AVG(ss.NumTstTakr) AS avg_test_takers
FROM schools AS s

WITH ranked_schools AS (
    SELECT
        s.School,
        s.County,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.County
            ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead DESC
        ) AS reading_rank
    FROM schools AS s
    JOIN satscores AS ss
        ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
      AND ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School
FROM ranked_schools
WHERE reading_rank <= 5;

SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools
WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
  AND Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY County
ORDER BY school_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH k8_by_city AS (
    SELECT City, COUNT(*) AS schools
    FROM schools
    WHERE GSserved = 'K-8'
    GROUP BY City
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM schools s
     JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
     WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-8'
       AND s.Magnet = 1
       AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types'
    ) AS magnet_multiple_provision_schools,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM k8_by_city) AS number_of_cities,
    City,
    schools AS schools_in_city

JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId

WITH youngest AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname, dob, nationality
    FROM drivers
    WHERE dob = (SELECT MAX(dob) FROM drivers)
),
first_race AS (
    SELECT y.driverId,
           r.name,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY y.driverId
               ORDER BY r.date, r.year, r.round, r.raceId
           ) AS rn
    FROM youngest AS y
    JOIN results AS res ON res.driverId = y.driverId
    JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
)
SELECT y.forename || ' ' || y.surname AS full_name,
       y.nationality,
       f.name AS first_race
FROM youngest AS y
LEFT JOIN first_race AS f
    ON f.driverId = y.driverId AND f.rn = 1;

  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS higher_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN ID END) -

FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
